content: As Ubbaas Lo7o Ooso
Ta ishatoo! Issi asi nagara ooththi beettiko intte qasse Ayanan lo7o dizayti iza ashketeththara zaaranaas bessees; gido attiin nekka izaade mala paacettontta mala ne hu7es naagetta.
Intte issoy issaa deexo tooho tookkite; hessa mala ooson Kirstoosa wogaa poleeta.
Issaadey aykkoka hanontta dishe bana gitasizaa misatikko hessaadey barkka bana baleththees.
Issi issi asi ba ooso barkka paacci xeello; hessafe guye hara asara bana ginasontta dishe izi bana ceeqisizaaz demmana.
Issi issi asi barkka ba tooho tookkanaas bessees.
Qaala tamaarzay oonikka ba tamaarda lo7o miishshaa ba astamaarezara gishetto.
Balettofte; Xoossi qilcca erenna; asi ba zeridaaro izo zaari maxana.
Ba asho amo kunththanaas zerizaadey ashoppe dhayo maxana; Ayana ufayssanaas zeridaadey gidikko ayanappe mernaa de7o maxana.
Ane nu lo7o ooso ooththanaas azalloko; nu ufays qanxxontta aggiko wodey gakkishin gakkida kath nu maxana.
Hessa gishshas nuus dandayettiko asa ubbaas harappeka ammaniza asaas ane lo7o ooththoos.
Wurseththa Zorenne Saroka
Tani ta kushera inttes ay mala gita pidalen xaafidaakko ane xeellite.
Coo kare baggara beettana koyza asati intte qaxxarettana mala wolqqaththana koyeettes; istti hessa ooththizay Kirstoosa masqale gishshas giidi goodettontta malassa.
Istti intte qaxxarettana mala koyzay intte ashon ceeqettanaas koyza gishshas attiin qaxxarettidayti wogaa naagizayta gidettenna.
Qasse alamey taas, tanikka alames kaqettida Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa masqalenppe attiin haran ceeqoy taappe haakko.
Qaxxarettiin woykko qaxxarettontta aggiin izas go7ay baa; go7ay ooraththa medheteth gideththa.
Hayssa ha azazoza kaalliza ubbatassinne Xoossa dere gidida Isra7eele asatas saroteththinne maareteththi gido.
Tani Yesusa malaata ta asateththan tookkadis; hessa gishshas ha7i tana oonikka waayisenna.
Ta ishatoo! Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa aadho kiyateththi inttenara gido! Amiin.
